description: The five-year MoU aims to promote academic and research collaboration
body_lead: The Survey of India (SoI), the national nodal agency for geospatial data under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Digital University of Kerala (DUK). The five-year MoU aims to promote academic and research collaboration in geo-informatics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning for automated feature extraction, Geodesy (Physical, Marine and Satellite), astronomy, and related engineering disciplines.
